baseline.note: Baseline captured read-only at the audit's start. The release-boundary worker owns all later changes on a separate branch; this inventory describes the baseline only.

scope_semantics.binding: NON-BINDING research record; current LICENSE_SCOPE.md and canonical release manifest govern.
scope_semantics.basis: Conservative release-boundary rules reviewed in the independent audit, projected onto the1951 baseline tracked paths. No MIT approval is inferred for CI/docs/tests/experiments.
scope_semantics.owner_decision: Owner approves basic engine and Python interface under MIT and reserves high-fidelity integrations, research, optimisation and datasets. Legal ownership/assignment is not determined by this audit.

inclusion_semantics.basis: DECLARED-RULE PROJECTION on BASELINE23df023, not an archive observation. Uses pinned scikit-build-core0.11.6 GitIgnoreSpec include-first/exclude-second/default-unignored semantics for baseline tracked paths.
limitations: The real backend walks all working-tree paths, including untracked files and symlink-followed directories; the baseline tracked-only projection cannot enumerate those.
Nested/untracked ignore rules and mutable .git/info/exclude are not modeled.
Compiled _core and generated metadata are not tracked source paths.
Observed final artefacts are owned by release-boundary and recorded separately; current source/packaging differs from baseline.

content_scan_coverage.notes: These sets partition baseline paths for the verbatim comparison (229+27+1615+80=1951). Attribution-marker candidates overlap; candidate count is not a claim of manual inspection. The earlier639 exclusion-filter listing was not content-scan coverage.
